question: Why is no other outline stated at this point in the text?
premises: There is no further division to be made there.
The subject matter is primary and must be known.
The sequence of other eligibilities follows from that.
inference: No other outline is stated here because the primary matter is clear and the sequence of further eligibilities is already implied.
uncertainties: adhikārāntarakramaḥ could refer to a sequence of topics or of qualified practitioners.
plain_english: Since there is no further division there, no other outline is stated here; that matter is primary and must be known, and from it follows the sequence of other eligibilities.
